subject: general
question: In a test, B got 50 marks while A got 75 marks, out of 110 maximum marks. What percentage of A’s marks was B’s marks? (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required % = (B ÷ A) × 100

= (50 ÷ 75) × 100

= (2 ÷ 3) × 100

= 66.67%

**∴ Answer = 66.67%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A’s marks = 75, B’s marks = 50

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Required % = (50 ÷ 75) × 100

⇒ = 0.6666 × 100

⇒ = 66.666…%

⇒ ≈ 66.67%

**∴ The correct answer is 66.67%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100

Fraction to Percentage

To convert fraction into %, multiply by 100

Simplification Trick

Reduce fraction first: 50/75 = 2/3 for faster calculation

Rounding Rule

Round to two decimal places: 66.666… ≈ 66.67%
